name: durable-projection-transient-remerge
body: The durable mutation's projection apply, extended to preserve transient pairings: `apg.layers.write_project_with` (src/layers.rs:2140) re-merges the assembled transient record set — the plan store plus all transient tier mirrors, the same assembly `apg.artifacts.assembled_records` builds for the transient path — after the DETACH of the mutation's exact FQN delta (the `solution.component.projection-delta-applier` deletion semantics), so a pre-existing `Feedback-[:Reviews]` edge on a changed FQN survives with no transient write in between. The durable path's record set is otherwise `apg.layers.ingest_tree` alone.
